يستصح (form X)

# يُسْتَصَحُّ (yustaṣaḥḥu) /jus.ta.sˤaħ.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَصَحَّ (istaṣaḥḥa)
# يَسْتَصِحَّ (yastaṣiḥḥa) /jas.ta.sˤiħ.ħa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
